description: Private retained SHA-3/SHAKE/cSHAKE AVX2 component with streamed exact-bit N/S prefix, affine authority, output/rehash and fail-closed cleanup. Runs in ordinary native processes, not inside VBS. Production crate sources and release gates unchanged.

miri.scope: Actual prefix source with a synthetic byte sink: independent bit concatenation, separate completion-proof fields, overflow/wrong-phase/excess rejection. Not real engine, AVX2, VBS or protected-memory qualification.
miri.initial_attempt: Sandbox prevented creation of the Miri sysroot cache. Retried with permission; all three tests passed. No test semantics changed.

source_binding.windows_checkout: Restored development checkout plus explicit source overlay, not a clean exact Git checkout
source_binding.scalar_test_adaptation: Existing oracle/lifecycle assertions retained; explicit authority construction and lifetime annotations substituted, plus new separate authority tests and generated hashlib vectors

limitations: No enclave entry/image, resident placement or supported accelerated SHA-3 host constructor yet
No full-page erasure, caller-frame/register/spill, dump or protected-stack qualification for this component
Miri uses an explicitly non-cryptographic sink; it does not execute inline assembly
Only native x86-64 AVX2 component execution; no Windows ARM64, production signing or migration qualification
